headline: Coris Bank International Côte d'Ivoire Launches $105 Million Public Share Offering
summary: Coris Bank International Côte d'Ivoire opened subscriptions to raise 62.74 billion CFA francs ($105 million) in a public offering ahead of listing on the regional BRVM stock exchange in January 2027.
why: The BRVM serves eight West African nations, where banking sector listings increase regional equity market liquidity and market capitalization.

impacts.name: Coris Bank International Côte d'Ivoire
impacts.why: The $105 million public offering provides capital to support bank growth ahead of listing.
